description: Empty bundle short-circuits to abstention before any SQL or provider call
All citations dropped by source filter (offrecord policy) -> abstention(all_filtered)
_seed_hint: Test seeds a non-empty bundle at runtime with all citations memory_policy='offrecord' so the gateway STEP_SOURCE_FILTER drops every cited message_version_id. evidence_message_version_ids=[] here means 'consumer must seed dynamic ids'; consumer's bundle is non-empty but post-filter set is empty.

description: Daily budget ceiling already consumed -> abstention(budget_exceeded)
_seed_hint: Test pre-loads llm_usage_ledger rows totalling > config.daily_ceiling_usd. Consumer must seed the ledger rows + a valid bundle (any version_id) so STEP_BUDGET_GUARD_ATOMIC trips on the pre-loaded daily total.

description: Provider raises rate-limit transient error -> abstention(provider_error) + ledger.error startswith provider_transient:
_seed_hint: Test wires a FakeProvider raising ProviderTransientError(subtype='rate_limit') and seeds a non-empty bundle so dispatch is reached. Consumer must inject a transient-error provider + seed dynamic ids.

description: Pre-seeded cache row served without provider call; cost_usd = 0; cache_hit = true
Provider returns citation_id NOT in surviving bundle -> abstention(provider_error) + ledger.error=citation_hallucination
_seed_hint: Test wires a FakeProvider returning citation_ids containing an id NOT in the seeded bundle. Consumer seeds a bundle + provider that emits hallucinated ids; gateway STEP_CITATION_ENFORCEMENT must reject.

description: Tombstone gate fires for a cited message_version_id -> abstention(forget_invalidated)
_seed_hint: Test seeds a non-empty bundle + a forget_event whose tombstone_key matches one of the cited message_version_ids (via 'message:' || chat_id || ':' || message_id form). Consumer must seed both.

description: Non-empty bundle, valid provider response with subset citations -> AnswerWithCitations + cost > 0
